issues.description: SealSaloon.acceptSupplyDelivery(String,int,int) is specified as public (+) in the UML/problem statement, but the reference solution declares it with package-private visibility (`static void ...`). Students following the UML will implement a public method, which may not match reflection-based checks or expected API visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution (and expected student API) to `public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)` to match the UML/spec.

issues.description: The problem statement contains conflicting guidance about SealSaloon.stock: it describes `final Stock stock` as an attribute of SealSaloon (suggesting an instance field), but also explicitly requires the `stock` attribute to be static/shared across instances. The reference solution uses `private static final Stock stock`, so students may be unsure whether to implement stock as per-instance or static.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the spec inconsistency by updating the problem statement/UML to clearly indicate `stock` is static (shared) or remove the static requirement if stock should be per-saloon; then align solution/template accordingly.
